title: [Master]  Basal rate on AAPSClient doesn't update occasionally (V3+WS)
symptom: Basal rate updates on AAPSClient occasionally do not reflect the temp basal set by AAPS, even though AAPS logs show the temp basal was set. The issue occurs with NSClientV3+WS and happens a few times a day, affecting all basal updates, not just temp 0 basal.
cause: The thread does not definitively establish a root cause. A maintainer guessed time sync, but the user reported standard time settings and the issue persisted. The user later found that switching to NSClientV1 resolved the issue, suggesting it is related to NSClientV3.
fix: The user switched to NSClientV1 and the issue stopped occurring. No other fix was provided.
evidence_quote: Switched to NSClientV1 yesterday, partly due to this issue and basal history is rendered wrong at Nightscout. This issue has yet to occur, so it seems to be related to NSV3 some how. :)
